items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: like Stan Levy told me that Bird -- Bird was like Jezebel.

ctx.x: Well, sure they did. Sure, I've heard -- I've had -- like Stan Levy told me that Bird -- Bird was like Jezebel. He led everybody, you know. Because not that he consciously tried to do this, but they just were followers, you know. They would do anything he did. You know. So -- but I knew a lot of musicians who were great musicians, didn't touch it. But it's a funny thing, I can tell you -- I hear records that Bird made, and I knew that he was high. And I heard other records that he wasn't high and he played…
How about smoking pot. Do you think that is a freeing influence in music?
